visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An animated sequence begins featuring a blue-skinned humanoid character dressed in a long white professional lab coat. The character is holding a small, cartoonish yellow cat in its arms. The background is an absolute solid black void. Large, bold blue and white stylized Chinese text is centered at the top of the frame. The character has wide circular eyes and a simple mouth line. (2) The scene cuts to a real-life young man with short, neat dark hair wearing a casual black short-sleeved t-shirt. He is standing against a neutral grey interior wall. He smiles broadly at the camera while raising his right hand to point his index finger upward. Bright yellow subtitles are overlaid at the bottom center of the frame. The lighting is bright and even, typical of indoor studio settings. (3) A series of real-world video clips are shown. First, a light brown cat is seen lying extremely flat and elongated on a polished wooden floor. Second, a tabby cat is filmed from a low angle as it flattens its body to squeeze through a very narrow gap beneath a wooden door. Third, a cat is shown slipping through a small rectangular opening in a white cabinet. Credits text appears in the top left corner. (4) The animation returns, showing the blue lab-coat character looking perplexed with downturned eyes. A mathematical formula "De = tc / tp" appears in a stylized green and white font on the black background. Below the formula, white text with green highlights explains the "Deborah Number." The character's posture is slightly slumped while holding the yellow cat. (5) New clips show a black cat navigating through the vertical wooden bars of a staircase railing with high flexibility. Following this, a dense, fluffy brown cat is seen inside a square transparent plastic container; the cat's body perfectly conforms to the corners and flat sides of the box, making it appear cubical. Subtitles continue to flow at the bottom. (6) A split-screen graphic is presented. On the left, a cat is shown squeezed into a narrow white plastic tube. On the right, a physics diagram illustrates capillary action within a narrow cylinder using red arrows. The background is a mix of natural indoor lighting for the cat and a clean white background for the technical diagram. (7) The final phase returns to the real-life male host in the grey-walled room. He gestures with his hand toward the side while continuing to speak. The video concludes with a split-screen animation of a yellow cat: one side labeled as a solid "固體" and the other as a liquid "液體." The host maintains a friendly facial expression with a slight smile.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 科學證明貓咪可以是液體? [Logo]: 維維維. (2) [Subtitle]: 你也有聽過「貓其實是液體」這樣的說法吧? (3) [Subtitle]: 比如這樣的. (4) [Subtitle]: 甚至是這樣的. (5) [Subtitle]: 等等等等. (6) [Subtitle]: 一個法國科學家就想能不能用科學來驗證呢? (7) [Subtitle]: 於是他用了一個物理概念叫「底波拉數」來判斷. (8) [Subtitle]: 簡單來說，就是觀察貓在短時間內的反應. (9) [Subtitle]: 貓如果在短短幾秒內就改變形狀，底波拉數就比較高. (10) [Subtitle]: 代表這時候的貓更接近固體. (11) [Subtitle]: 如果他慢慢適應容器，那底波拉數比較低. (12) [Subtitle]: 這時候的貓更接近液體. (13) [Subtitle]: 他還發現，老貓的底波拉數更小，年輕貓更大. (14) [Subtitle]: 所以老貓更接近固體，小貓更像液體! (15) [Subtitle]: 而且貓咪還有很多液體才有的特性. (16) [Subtitle]: 比如：毛細現象：貓咪像水一樣，輕鬆黏貼各種表面. (17) [Subtitle]: 接觸角：貓靠著物體的時候，像水倒很滿時形成的弧形. (18) [Subtitle]: 黏滯性：貓看起來就像是黏稠的液體. (19) [Subtitle]: 科學家的結論是——貓咪既是固體也是液體! (20) [Subtitle]: 你覺得呢?

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain and educate viewers by humorously validating the popular 'cats are liquid' internet meme through real scientific concepts like the Deborah number and physical properties of fluids. It uses a high-energy delivery, cat montages, and simplified graphics to make complex physics accessible and engaging for a general social media audience.
